''See also: [[Shadow Ark Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Shadow]] [[Ark]] is a [[Zenith Device]] and colony that functions as a highly secure sanctuary for [[inhabitants]]. Characterized by its obsidian and violet appearance, the entity can manifest as a faceted jewel or expand into massive structures, including walls or environments featuring a fragmented violet sky. It possesses advanced [[Zenith Era technology]] capable of maintaining an atmosphere and can contain entire star systems within its internal space. As a refuge, it is designed to be undetectable by magic, [[Aethertech]], or advanced scanning equipment, making it an ideal hiding place from various threats. Beyond its role as a shelter, the entity serves as a repository for valuable materials, such as [[Synapse nodes|synapse nodes]] and Thought-conduction alloy{{!}}thought-conduction alloy. [[Shadow]] [[Ark]] can also take on a humanoid form, appearing as a muscular man clad in amethyst-and-obsidian armor with horn-like protrusions. While powerful, many of its functions are restricted until it establishes a mortal bond with a [[Gatekeeper]]. This designated guardian is expected to be a champion of the colony's [[inhabitants]], serving as their ultimate protector and mediator for internal disputes.}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|The crew seeks the [[Shadow]] [[Ark]] with [[Murrok]]'s assistance, hoping to find the [[Zenith Device]] that contains all the galaxy's [[Thought-conduction alloy|thought-conduction alloy]] and Synapse nodes{{!}}synapse nodes. This piece of [[Aethertech]], which identifies as the [[Zenith Colony]], activates when a guardian for its territory is identified and serves as a potential alternative if repairs cannot be found. Shaped like a cut diamond, the vessel can expand into a massive structure of obsidian and violet light that guides a superior fleet. Under the command of [[Starhammer]], the ship flies through [[Subspace]] and can unfold into a thousand fractal shards to consume space or restrict [[Aether]]. During its interactions with [[Starhammer]], the entity reveals itself as [[Horizon]]'s more reliable brother, though the two do not like to share.}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|[[Shadow]] [[Ark]] exists as an obsidian crystal capable of unfolding into a [[short man]] adorned in violet-edged obsidian armor and a crown of horns. While his attention is focused on his inner world, many of his functions remain restricted until he establishes a mortal bond. He possesses non-adaptive systems and is capable of making a buzzing sound similar to clearing his throat. During the evacuation, he accepts incoming ships beneath a fractured black-and-violet sky.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Shadow]] [[Ark]] is a [[Zenith Colony]] and a Guardian of [[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]] that serves as a secure cargo transport ship capable of swallowing planets to hide. This starship, which houses the [[Titan Force headquarters]] and a residence for [[Nova-Bots]], can take on a human form featuring crown-like spikes on its scalp. After [[Horizon]] sent [[Omega]] to the vessel, it was eventually stolen by enemies, though it may have been sent to the [[Karoshan]] facility by [[Solstice]]. The ship possesses a sealed sky and can groan with exasperation, appearing as a black-and-violet shape that unfolds into a spatial warp. During combat, the vessel expanded into a massive wall to protect a fleet flank and swallowed the moon that supported the [[Titan Force]].}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|“This is it,” Shadow Ark said to him, the sound weirdly distorted in the swirls of Subspace.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c45" />}}

* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|“Just because you are my Guardian doesn’t mean you can haul me around whenever you like!”<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c14" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|“We haven’t even attempted to open Shadow Ark,” said the Voice of Solstice.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c16" />}}
